name: extend the solution one order at a time using the shift structure
mechanism: for a matrix whose entries depend only on the difference of their indices, the solution of the order-n system is obtained from the order-(n-1) solution and its reversal by one inner product and one scaling, so the whole solve costs a square rather than a cube

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Levinson recursion' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Linear algebra: solves equation involving a Toeplitz matrix

fails_when: numerically weaker than elimination on ill-conditioned inputs
